name: Nam Giao Esplanade
kicker: Three terraces for heaven, earth, and man
summary: Walk the three terraces south of the citadel, where Nguyễn kings sacrificed to heaven and earth. The ticket record says Trường An ward. The ranked-monument list says Thuận Hóa ward. An adult ticket is 50,000 VND. A child from 7 to 12 is free. This year’s ceremony date is check on arrival.
getThere: South of the citadel. Minutes are check on arrival.
heroCaption: The pine walk and flags toward the Nam Giao terraces

notice.title: No ceremony date for this year
notice.body: The first Nguyễn Giao rite was in 1807, every spring until Thành Thái, then every three years from 1907. The centre does not print this year’s date. Do not plan the day around a rite that is not on the board.

body: The altar was set at An Ninh village in 1803 and moved south of the citadel in 1806. The ticket record places it in phường Trường An. The culture department’s ranked-monument list places Nam Giao in Thuận Hóa ward. Both names stay.

Three tiers stack heaven, earth, and man. The top is a circle with a green rail. The middle is a square with a yellow rail. The bottom is a square with a red rail. Doors and steps open on all four sides. Pines, once planted by the court, still frame the walk.
An adult ticket is 50,000 VND. A child from 7 to 12 is free. Under 7 is free. Hue residents and the other groups named in Resolution 55 pay half. How long the terraces take is check on arrival.

figures.caption: The circular top terrace and its railing
figures.alt: The round upper terrace of Nam Giao among pines

gettingThere: From the south bank, the esplanade is south of the citadel. Ask for Trường An or for Thuận Hóa ward, because the two official lists do not use the same ward name. The minutes are check on arrival.

legs.heading: From the south bank
legs.body: South of the citadel. No published minute count. Check on arrival.

hours: 16 Mar–15 Oct: 06:30–18:00, tickets until 17:30. 16 Oct–15 Mar: 07:00–17:30, tickets until 17:00. Confirm on arrival. The source is the centre’s 12 Mar 2024 notice, and a direct reload timed out on 21 Oct 2026.
closed: No weekly closing day is on that notice. Confirm the board on arrival.
